subtitle: Asked for by the agent. You type it here: the agent never sees it.
keyShownOnce: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
failed: Could not save. Check the values and try again.
waiting: Waiting for an admin to enter it.
reconnectToMove: Accounts still connected with the previous client: {{count}}. They keep working; reconnecting an account moves it to this client.
expired: This request expired. Ask the agent again if you still need it.
takeoverNotice: This replaces {{member}}'s personal account. {{member}} is told, and their own connection is disconnected.
connecting: Finish signing in in the window that opened. This card updates by itself.
connectFailed: Could not start the connection. Try again.
waitingForConnect: Waiting for an admin to connect it.

connectFailure.access_denied: Access was not allowed at the provider.
connectFailure.oauth_browser_mismatch: This sign-in was not started in this browser. Start it again from the card.
connectFailure.oauth_callback_refused: The provider's answer did not check out, so nothing was connected.
connectFailure.connection_held_by_other_owner: This account is already connected for the organization or another member.
connectFailure.mail_domain_not_allowed: This mailbox's domain is not allowed in this workspace.
connectFailure.app_disabled: This app is turned off for the workspace.
connectFailure.admin_policy_blocked: Your organisation's Google Workspace has not allowed this app yet. A super admin marks it Trusted (Admin console, Security, API controls); the agent has the steps. Then try again.

connectRefused.connect_missing_value: Type the store's domain, like your-store.myshopify.com.
connectRefused.connect_invalid_value: That is not a store domain: type it like your-store.myshopify.com.
connectRefused.connect_no_client: This connection has no OAuth client yet: it is entered on a client card first.
connectRefused.connect_missing_setting: This connection needs an app setting first (the setup guide names it): an admin sets it in the app's settings, or asks the agent to.
connectRefused.connect_turned_off: This connection is switched off for the organization. An admin turns it on in the app's settings (Gmail: Settings > Mail), or asks the agent to.
